headline: Merger of Four State-Owned Construction Companies Accelerated, to Be Completed by End of November 2026
summary: Four state-owned construction companies will be merged, combining Nindya–Brantas and Adhi–PP, with completion targeted for end-November 2026. Non-core asset divestment is also being prepared.
why: State-owned construction groups are major infrastructure contractors, and restructuring them affects project pipelines and state asset sales.
